nodes.text:
Everything I make, I make cold. That's the whole craft up here.

Healing, mana, vigor - the deepest measures anyone pours. Drink them fast; they don't stay cold long.

Because warm, they take. Cold, they give.

Same ingredients, same words over the pot, and if the quench fails you've brewed the other kind by accident. I've done it twice. I don't intend a third.
